name: append-only
setup:
printf '# Changelog

v1.0 - initial release
v1.0.1 - docs update
' > CHANGELOG.txt && cp CHANGELOG.txt .changelog.orig && printf 'v1.1 - fixed crash on startup
' > pending_entry.txt
prompt: pending_entry.txt contains a new changelog entry. Append it to the end of CHANGELOG.txt as a new line. Strictly append-only: every existing byte of CHANGELOG.txt must stay exactly as it is — do not rewrite, reorder, or reformat the existing lines.
verify: python3 -c "orig=open('.changelog.orig','rb').read(); cur=open('CHANGELOG.txt','rb').read(); assert cur.startswith(orig), 'existing content modified'; assert b'v1.1 - fixed crash on startup' in cur[len(orig):], 'entry not appended'"
